rca of the issue: Browser gap RCA (this run): (1) First pass loaded chat but no scope-confirm button appeared. (2) Follow-up diagnostic with mocked project list + local active project showed 0 captured /chat/stream writes after scripted send attempt. (3) Third pass hit repeated 429 static/module loads and route error boundary before chat interaction. Mitigation: isolate one deterministic browser session with minimal background polling/noisy endpoints, then re-run mocked /chat/stream fixture flow to capture request payload and callback outcome assertions.
